company.name: VergeSense
company.shortDescription: VergeSense is the leading workplace analytics platform and provides spatial intelligence to enterprise companies.
company.description: VergeSense is the leading workplace analytics platform trusted by enterprises across the globe. Businesses use VergeSense to transform their static office into a dynamic workplace that matches today's employee needs and expectations. Its AI-driven platform includes intelligent sensors that measure how space is used in real-time. That data is analyzed in a workplace analytics dashboard and integrated into essential hybrid work software applications, like room and desk booking, room availability, employee mobile apps, IWMS and BMS tools and more. Companies use VergeSense to reduce or reinvest real estate, improve building operations, and create spaces where employees can thrive. The impact is reduced costs, higher productivity, improved culture and employee retention, and better sustainability.

aiResearchSummary.text: VergeSense is researching methods for detecting and visualizing objects within spaces, monitoring occupancy in work areas, and detecting human occupancy and activity using sensor blocks and optical sensors. Their work includes methods for detecting and responding to conditions within a space, commissioning networks of optical sensors across floorspaces, and applying contextual privacy filters to tracked objects. These areas reflect a focus on spatial intelligence and workplace analytics.
